description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests related to wireless network configuration, including setting SSID parameters, WPS setup, MAC filtering, and network enabling/disabling. It interacts with a device management backend via getStr and setStr functions, and manages JSON-encoded configurations sent via POST.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates a WPS PIN checksum, supporting 4 and 8 digit PINs, using standard checksum algorithm.

methods.name: validFilterParam
methods.description: Validates filter parameters array, ensuring character and MAC address validity.
